key_insight: AI can help unify instability studies of 3D all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking diagnosis, mechanism discovery, reliability prediction, and stabilization design.
engineering_relevance: The review shows how AI can guide more durable inorganic perovskite devices for photovoltaics, photodetectors, and LEDs by improving prediction and mitigation of thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical degradation.
method: Microscopic mechanism analysis and pathway mapping
Consequence/reliability modeling plus engineering strategy optimization
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that AI is useful because conventional studies are limited by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification.
watch_item: Current AI approaches are constrained by inconsistent data quality and protocols, which can limit interpretability and transferability across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
